detail.longDescription: Python released emergency updates for 3.15.1, 3.14.9 and 3.13.17 after the emSign certificate authority incident. They bundle updated pip and certifi trust data. Existing virtual environments still need separate pip and uv updates. For Linux admins, check Python installations, build pipelines and virtual environments. Certificate trust is a supply-chain security issue. https:// blog.python.org/2026/10/python -3151-3149-31317/ # Python # Linux # OpenSource # Security
